LanguageData.CMI.EffectBasis: The left column is the part's current efficiency. Replacement efficiency on the right is its defined base value, not the pawn's overall capacity. Other effects use the installed current stage or the candidate's initial stage. Consult the description and info card for conditional and custom effects.
LanguageData.CMI.SettingsHelp: Gray entries are uninstalled candidates. Vanilla and same-family replacements are hidden below the current part efficiency. Other mod families remain visible. Special abilities are not valued by this numeric filter: reveal inferior candidates or assign separate families. Ghoul, mechanitor and other target restrictions are enforced. This mod does not schedule operations.
LanguageData.CMI.Legend: Installed: health-entry color. Uninstalled: gray. Compare against current part efficiency, including natural parts. Other mod families remain separate. Show inferior candidates bypasses comparison only, not target restrictions.
LanguageData.CMI.Skipped: Could not inspect {0} surgeries. See the game log.
LanguageData.CMI.Empty: No installed implants or discoverable implant surgeries for this pawn.
LanguageData.CMI.Candidate: Uninstalled candidate. Not all special effects can be compared.
LanguageData.CMI.InferiorTip: Below current part efficiency or inferior to an installed same-family implant. This does not evaluate the value of special abilities.
LanguageData.CMI.Dead: This pawn is dead; ordinary installation is unavailable.
LanguageData.CMI.ResearchLocked: The surgery is not unlocked or is currently disabled.
LanguageData.CMI.BodyCompatible: The surgery's current pawn/body conditions are met.
LanguageData.CMI.ConditionUnknown: Could not evaluate this mod's surgery conditions.
LanguageData.CMI.NoGuarantee: Use Operations to schedule surgery. Availability also depends on materials, doctors, permissions and other mod-specific checks.
